The code was already correct — the `dist/` you were inspecting was stale (built 06:47, before the commit at 10:11). After rebuilding:

- `hu/index.html` → `og-hu.png`
- `de/index.html` → `og-de.png`
- `en-GB/index.html` → `og-en-GB.png`
- `ja`, `zh-Hans` (non-Latin) → `og.png`, as intended by [ogImageUrl](docs/.vitepress/config.ts#L460-L463)
